name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 3 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2026-06-02, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 4.74 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
